evals.prompt: Find me recent studies on AAC for nonverbal toddlers with autism
evals.expected_output: A clean HTML file with up to 5 peer-reviewed results about AAC for nonverbal toddlers, sourced from PubMed/Autism Speaks, with colored topic tags and clickable titles.

assertions.name: html_file_created
assertions.description: An HTML file exists in the outputs directory

assertions.name: max_five_results
assertions.description: The HTML contains no more than 5 result cards

assertions.name: has_report_header
assertions.description: The HTML has a header with report title and date generated

assertions.name: titles_are_links
assertions.description: Result titles are wrapped in clickable <a href> links

assertions.name: has_topic_tags
assertions.description: At least one colored topic tag/badge is present in the HTML

assertions.name: no_blocked_sources
assertions.description: No citations from WebMD, Healthline, Psychology Today, or parent blogs

assertions.name: aac_content_present
assertions.description: At least one result explicitly addresses AAC (Augmentative and Alternative Communication)
